title: Hydrodynamic Attributes
description: Defines the dynamic properties of parts in fluids (air, water), including drag, lift, etc. Used to simulate aerodynamic and hydrodynamic effects.

scale.description: Scale factor, used to adjust hydrodynamic effects as a whole.

effective_range.description: Effective calculation range in three directions, unit in m, when obstructions are detected within this distance in the corresponding axis movement direction, the actual air drag coefficient of the part will be reduced, to simulate drag reduction effects such as streamline flow caused by vehicle shell obstruction.

transonic_amplifier.description: Transonic amplification coefficient, used to simulate drag changes during transonic speeds. When speed approaches sonic speed, drag increases sharply.

front_drag.description: Front drag coefficient list, typically contains two values: [low-speed coefficient, high-speed coefficient].

x_lift.description: X-axis lift coefficient list. Usually empty, indicating no X-axis lift is generated.

y_lift.description: Y-axis lift coefficient list. Usually empty, indicating no Y-axis lift is generated.

z_lift.description: Z-axis lift coefficient list. Usually empty, indicating no Z-axis lift is generated.
